system.description: When you are within 10 feet of an allied creature, you can spend one superiority die. All allied creatures, including yourself, within range gain a +2 Bonus to their AC, and all Saving throws made until the beginning of your next turn so long as they remain within 10 feet of you. If any affected creature would take damage you reduce the damage taken by the result of the superiority die.
